---
title: "Stata workshops"
---

Four workshops, in the order to take them:

1. [Stata Introduction](intro.qmd): the interface and do-files, reading and writing data, summary statistics, basic graphs and data management. For people new to Stata.
2. [Stata Data Management](data.qmd): generating and replacing variables, missing values, variable types, merging and appending, summarised data sets.
3. [Stata Regression Models](models.qmd): models for continuous and binary outcomes, interactions and categorical predictors, saving results, quantities of interest.
4. [Stata Graphics](graphics.qmd): univariate and bivariate graphs.

Before any of them, follow the [installation page](install.qmd). Each workshop's page links to its materials (data, cheat sheets, a BLANK do-file to type along in, and the exercise solutions). The notes show the commands without their output; run them in Stata to see it.
